message:
Where Couples Overspend on Their Wedding

The common budget-busters:
• a guest list that quietly grows (catering, bar and rentals all scale per guest);
• upgrades added late, like a bigger bar package or more florals;
• the small line items, such as tips, postage, alterations and vendor meals, that add up fast.

Set aside about 5% as a buffer from day one.
